verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies that Devin's work ends up in pull requests: Devin Review with Auto-Fix has Devin respond to code review comments and iterate on CI failures, and tasks can be delegated from tickets. No item says Devin automatically opens a PR when a task completes, or that this behaviour can be configured. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Devin opens a PR on task completion, a configuration setting or API parameter to enable auto-PR, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
